name: @etzhayyim/business-person-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of business-person (public registry of corporate officers/executives/board members + appointments) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS. Tier-1 public-disclosure data only; full PII (Tier-3) is delegated to natural-person via DID link. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-0014.
